analysis_options.api: Direct RuleMultiCollapse::applyOp/apply_op invocation; no ActionGroup or other Rule runs
analysis_options.funcdata: Locked BfdArchitecture over the pinned Git-blob curl input supplies Ghidra Funcdata, address spaces, TypeFactory, and opcode lists. Each Ghidra case clears prior state. Rugra creates an isolated synthetic Funcdata per case.
analysis_options.ir: All observed ops are alive and block-integrated before invocation. Register leaves are SSA inputs; outputs are inserted unique-space written Varnodes; constants are fresh const-space Varnodes per site (the opSetInput clone rule makes any two same-valued constant objects distinct, which is exactly how the abort shape forms). The functional case has ordered left->merge and right->merge CFG edges with PHI slots matching predecessor order.
analysis_options.normalization: No Ghidra/Rugra behavior difference is normalized or removed. The crash-case after-record intentionally differs: Ghidra prints its observed SIGSEGV termination of the forked child while Rugra prints the full completed absolute-constant-collapse state. The func_eq after-record is compared after masking only the two dead MULTIEQUAL op-state entries (OPBANK-0001 NULL input-slot cardinality). All other Varnode offsets, identities, flags, SeqNum time/order, slots, bank/list/block/CFG order, definitions, descendants, marks, and alive/dead state are preserved byte-for-byte.
analysis_options.crash_reproduction: The locked e40ed130 oracle dereferences defcopyr->getDef()==null at ruleaction.cc:3306 when defcopyr is an unwritten constant selected by ruleaction.cc:3254-3257 and functionalEquality returns true for two same-valued constant objects (expression.cc:409-412). The C++ fixture reproduces this in a forked child (parent stdout flushed before fork) and records result=SIGSEGV; Rugra's post-fix absolute-constant path completes with result=1.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; RuleMultiCollapse and fixture construction are deterministic

observation_schema.format: Six fixed-order UTF-8 records (before/after for three cases) with a final newline; the Ghidra stream's crash-case after-record is the parent's waitpid observation of the forked child
observation_schema.identity: Pointer/Arc addresses are map keys only. Initial blocks, ops, and Varnodes use semantic names; transformation-created values use deterministic discovery names. Removed Varnodes are tombstones and are never dereferenced.
observation_schema.cfg_and_op_state: Every synthetic block's exact index, predecessor order, successor order, and op order; whole op-tree, alive/dead lists, and LOAD/STORE/RETURN/CALLOTHER opcode-specific lists; every tracked op including dead ops with opcode, dead/mark/marker/commutative/modified flags, parent, address, immutable SeqNum time, mutable SeqNum order, ordered nullable inputs, and output identity.
observation_schema.varnode_state: Exact VarnodeBank location/definition order and every tracked/discovered Varnode's membership, space, size, semantic/raw offset, create index, complete raw flags, mark/class/heritage state, defining op, and occurrence-aware ordered descendant op.slot edges.
observation_schema.raw_difference_policy: The runner pins both complete output streams via the comparand block. Exactly two record classes may differ: (1) func_eq_skiplist_def_preserved/after differs only inside the two dead MULTIEQUAL op-state entries where Ghidra prints inputs=[-,-] NULL slot cardinality and Rugra prints inputs=[] (OPBANK-0001); (2) const_pair_distinct_objects/after is the oracle's SIGSEGV observation versus Rugra's completed absolute-constant collapse state, which is the documented RULE-MULTICOLLAPSE-ABORT-0001 divergence (the oracle's own crash proves its func_eq path cannot express this shape).

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-rule-multi-collapse-abort-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents
comparand.rust_crate_source_policy: Every crate file comes from the pinned base commit a51e0c5c14a5dec130d4e7a050e2512c9c518280 Git blob except the src/ruleaction.rs overlay, which is taken from the live working tree

OPBANK-0001.detail: Ghidra dead PcodeOps retain NULL input-slot cardinality; Rugra's Vec-based inrefs are cleared by op_destroy. The func_eq after-record is compared with only the dead MULTIEQUAL op-state entries masked; every other field must stay byte-identical.

RULE-MULTICOLLAPSE-0001.detail: Parent fixture: root/self-loop/nested/functional-CSE/functional-LOAD target projections matched; this fixture reuses its Fixture dump format.

overall_status_rationale: Five of six records match byte-for-byte (one masked by the pre-registered OPBANK-0001 dead-slot representation limit). The crash-case record documents that the locked oracle itself cannot survive the abort shape; Rugra's completed absolute-constant collapse is the cc:3279/cc:3334-intended behavior. The case-level non-MATCH record keeps this fixture below full MATCH.
